result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major duplicate-content problem in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. Other partially visible items are attributable to horizontal scrolling and bottom-of-viewport cutoff and were not treated as defects.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are exact duplicates: both show the same poke bowl image, '15-25 min', 'Green Bowl Poké' name, and '€0.90 delivery'. This makes it appear as if the same restaurant is listed twice consecutively.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the carousel by restaurant/location ID. If these are intentionally two different branches of the same restaurant, differentiate them with a location qualifier, distinct image, distance, or address so users can tell them apart.
